chunks: From him, from ʿAlī ibn Khālid, from Aḥmad ibn al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī, from ʿAmr ibn Saʿīd al-Madāʾinī, from Muṣaddiq ibn Ṣadaqah, from ʿAmmār al-Sābāṭī, who said:
I asked him about vomit that affects the garment and it is not washed. He said: “There is no harm.”

key_terms.الثَّوْبَ: the garment or clothing affected by the vomit
key_terms.الْقَيْءِ: vomit; the substance asked about in relation to impurity on clothing
key_terms.فَلَا يُغْسَلُ: it is not washed; the condition mentioned in the question
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; a formula indicating permissibility or absence of objection

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on vomit that gets on a garment if it is not washed?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning vomit on clothing. The Imam عليه السلام states that there is no problem if the garment is not washed from it, indicating that such a case does not invalidate its use on that basis.
